environment.description: Deployed on a bare EC2 Amazon Linux 2 instance running Kestrel directly. The /var/app/exports directory is on the root filesystem with no mount namespace isolation. The application runs as the 'appuser' which has read access to /etc/shadow and /var/app/exports is a regular directory. No API gateway or reverse proxy in front of the service - clients connect directly to port 5000. The filesystem supports symlinks and there are no SELinux/AppArmor policies restricting symlink creation or following.

config.filesystem: ext4, symlinks enabled, no mount namespaces
